title: 第5章 你们可知百事通前辈闭关意味着什么第6章 我没考虑过会有这种状况啊
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
“百事通前辈闭关了？”
宗主和宗门长老得知此事后，都很是诧异。
以往招新考核的第二关都是由百事通对新人们出题并打分，这么多年来从未出现过差错。
而且百事通前辈近千年内也从未闭关过。
怎么此次在这种关键节点突然闭关呢？
宗主回忆了一会儿，突然拍手称道：“这是好事啊，你们可知百事通前辈闭关意味着什么？”
“意味着百事通前辈闭关了！”
大长老脱口而出。
宗主忍不住翻了个白眼。
‘这脑回路如此奇葩，我当时竟然推荐他当宗门大长老，我真该死啊！
“错了！”
二长老反驳。
宗主眼前一亮，看来智商这块还得看老二。
二长老痛心疾首的说道：“这意味着这次考核第二关无法进行，我那些刁难的题目白想了！”
宗主无语了，都啥时候了，还想着那些该死的题目。
“我说的是好事，你懂什么叫好事吗？注意审题！”
二长老若有所思，“这对那些参加第二关考试的弟子来说，确实是好事啊！”
众人想起之前那个抽象到极致的的问题，突然觉得二长老说的有道理。
不但对弟子好，对宗门来说也是件好事。
最起码不会把那些脑子正常的弟子给筛出去。

宗主揉了揉眉心，失去了交流的欲望，直接说道：
“你们可还记得，上次百事通前辈闭关改良了我宗的修炼功法，大大提高了我宗弟子的修炼速度。”
不给长老说话的机会，宗主直接说道：
“这次百事通前辈闭关的如此突然，我想前辈一定是有了新的灵感，都来不及跟我等通知一声，便急匆匆的闭关去了。”
大长老和二长老这才恍然大悟，“原来如此！”
“百事通前辈关于修仙的理论的研究乃当世之最，这次闭关肯定会有重大突破！”
五长老拿着罗盘说道：“昨夜我夜观星象，发现近几日会出现影响我宗未来的关键事件，但却无法预测是好是坏。”
“本以为今天招新能招收一位绝世天骄，从而影响我宗未来，如今看来，这个关键点在百事通前辈身上。”
“如此看来，对我宗确实是大好事啊！”
“那现在怎么办？百事通前辈闭关是好事，但这次招新怎么解决。”
二长老还是没有忘记他心心念念的招新工作。
content_en:
"Senior Baishi Tong is in seclusion?"
When the sect leader and sect elders learned about this, they were very surprised.
In the past, in the second level of the new recruitment assessment, Bestong set questions and scored the new candidates, and there has never been an error in these years.
Moreover, Senior Baishi Tong has never been in seclusion in the past thousand years.
Why did it suddenly shut down at such a critical juncture this time?
The sect leader recalled it for a while, then suddenly clapped his hands and said, "This is a good thing. Do you know what Senior Bai Shitong means by retreating?"
"It means that Senior Bai Shitong has gone into seclusion!"
The great elder blurted out.
The sect leader couldn't help but rolled his eyes.
‘This brain circuit is so weird, I actually recommended him to be the elder of the sect. I really deserve to die!
"Wrong!"
The second elder retorted.
The sect leader's eyes lit up, it seemed that the second child's IQ was still up to him.
The second elder said sadly: "This means that the second level of this assessment cannot be carried out, and all my difficult questions were in vain!"
The sect leader was speechless. What time was it? He was still thinking about those damn questions.
"I'm talking about good things. Do you know what good things are? Pay attention to the questions!"
The second elder thought thoughtfully, "This is indeed a good thing for those disciples who are taking the second level exam!"
Everyone thought of the extremely abstract question before, and suddenly felt that what the second elder said made sense.
Not only is it good for the disciples, it is also a good thing for the sect.
At the very least, those disciples with sane minds will not be screened out.
The sect leader rubbed his eyebrows, lost the desire to communicate, and said directly:
"Do you still remember that Senior Bai Shitong improved our sect's cultivation methods last time in retreat, which greatly increased the cultivation speed of our sect's disciples?"
Without giving the elder a chance to speak, the sect leader said directly:
"Senior Baishi Tong retreated so suddenly this time. I think senior must have had new inspiration. He didn't even have time to wait for notification from me, so he hurriedly went into retreat."
The First Elder and the Second Elder suddenly realized, "That's it!"
"Senior Bai Shitong's research on the theory of cultivating immortals is the best in the world. There will definitely be a major breakthrough in this retreat!"
The fifth elder held the compass and said: "I watched the stars last night and found that key events that will affect the future of our sect will occur in the next few days, but I can't predict whether they will be good or bad."
"I thought that today's recruitment would recruit a peerless talent, which would affect the future of our sect. Now it seems that the key point lies in Senior Bai Shitong."
"From this perspective, it is indeed a good thing for our sect!"
"Then what should we do now? It's a good thing for Senior Baishi Tong to retreat, but how to solve the problem of recruiting new people this time?"
The second elder still has not forgotten the recruitment work that he has been thinking about.
